verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven virtual card issuance (docs-4, docs-17), a full-featured Test environment that 'behaves like production' for pre-production simulation (docs-26, docs-11), and PCI-safe SDK access to sensitive card data (docs-14), supporting the core of the story. However, issuance is gated on an 'approved application' and in-house KYC/KYB review (docs-4, docs-23), which implies an onboarding/approval step rather than a pure self-serve sandbox-to-live flip, and no citation explicitly confirms a single API call returning PAN, CVV, and expiry together at issuance. Missing for 10: explicit one-call PAN/CVV/expiry return confirmation, and explicit evidence that going live requires no sales/underwriting interaction.
